episodes.hook: Some sounds doh travel through air. Some travel through blood.
episodes.reveal: Behind a vendor stall, an old bois waits like it has been listening for years. When Kai touches it, the street forgets how to breathe.

episodes.narrator_script:
Some sounds doh travel through air. Some travel through blood.

In Trinidad, Carnival light wakes old roads, old houses, and old warnings.

Kai Baptiste had one plan tonight: grab doubles and gone.

Full belly. Steady spirit. That was his rule. But tonight, the rule failed.

A beat followed him through the crowd. No pan. No drum. No speaker. Just wood... calling his name.

Behind a vendor stall, an old bois waited like it had been listening for years.

When Kai touched it, the street forgot how to breathe. Every carving opened. Every rhythm turned toward him.

The elders called it a debt. The children called it a ghost. The stick called him by name.

And every piece of wood in the road answered.
episodes.script_notes: Establish Kai's humanity first (school, hunger, doubles). Slow build of supernatural. Single-voice narrator sets tone: 'Every warrior hears the call. Kairo's time has come.'

episodes.script_notes: This episode is quieter, reflective. Focus on community healing, not spectacle. Show cost of corruption on individuals. Selah's arc should feel earned (she chose differently than her father). Kai's new role is bittersweet (growth + responsibility). Set up S2 by expanding geography.
episodes.caption_patois: Healing is its own kind of battle. 🌿💖 #OPAIJA #CaribbeanAnime

episodes.title: The Rhythm Eternal
episodes.canonical_hook: Season 1 ultimate finale; Kai's journey full circle; S2 seeds planted
major_beats: Large gayelle festival (Carnival-adjacent, celebratory)
Community witnesses team's triumph over Marius
Kai performs public stick dance with Malik (showing teamwork, respect)
Nia performs elaborate lavway solo (her voice carries island history)
Jabari records it all, plans to share island traditions globally (TikTok for Kalenda)
Asha honored as healer + warrior (new role model for youth)
Tariq invites Kai to Tobago permanently (offer, connection established)
Selah remains with team; Papa Etienne begins mentoring her (redemption continuing)
Mother Lall gives Kai family heirloom: his mother's original stick (emotional)
Kai learns his mother was once powerful Guardian; she chose to protect him over duty
Kai accepts his doubled heritage: warrior + protector of peace
Final scene: Kai at gayelle with team, doubles in hand, watching new young warriors train
Voiceover: Narrator reflects on cycle of resistance, culture, rhythm
Season 1 END: Island at peace; future threats forming (S2 tease: Marius's lieutenant seen on satellite island)

episodes.conflict: Resolved (Marius defeated); new conflicts emerging (S2 setup)
episodes.doubles_moment: EXTENDED DOUBLES SCENE. Kai at Mother Lall's stall. She wraps six orders. Hands them to the whole team. First time everyone gets doubles together. Brief silence. Then Jabari: 'This is it, right?' Kai looks at the bois. 'This is it.'

episodes.hook: Some debts cannot wait. Some rhythms cannot be silenced.

episodes.escalation: Kai and Malik — rival and rival — stand together at the gayelle entrance. No words. Just two bois.
episodes.cliffhanger_alt: SEASON 1 CLIFFHANGER: The gayelle arena transforms. Marius Vale is already inside. 'I said one drum. I meant it.' The Silence Pulse begins. And somewhere, every drum in Trinidad goes quiet.

episodes.script_notes: Finale is celebratory but grounded. Kai's arc is complete (reluctant hero → accepted Guardian with support). Show that victory is collective, not individual. Doubles return full-circle as cultural anchor. Nia's solo lavway should be season's most visually impressive sequence. S2 hook is subtle (lieutenant spotted on map), not intrusive. Emphasize that this story continues, island-to-island.
episodes.caption_patois: One island. One rhythm. One cycle continues. 🌍🥁 #OPAIJA #CaribbeanAnime #SeasonFinale

production_notes: All 12 episodes follow canonical rules: Kai eats doubles before/after major battles, all characters have rounded chins + African noses + full lips, Jabari's drums are L-shaped wooden kalinda style, Nia's lavway is call-and-response, Marius's face hidden until Ep 10. Patois density maintained at 10-15%. Narrator is single omniscient voice throughout.
